related.title: Friis 前端：LNA 增益如何抑制後級雜訊
related.titleEn: Friis front end: how LNA gain suppresses downstream noise
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 120 MHz 與 140 MHz，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 120 MHz and 140 MHz, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋2.4 linear noise factor與2.04 linear noise factor，建立noise_cascade.csv、線性/dB對照、壓縮排除證據，並完成以下驗收：教學門檻Ftotal<=2.1時高增益組通過雜訊條件，但仍需獨立線性度預算。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 2.4 linear noise factor and 2.04 linear noise factor; create noise_cascade.csv, linear/dB conversions and compression counterevidence; apply this acceptance decision: At the teaching limit Ftotal<=2.1, only the high-gain case passes the noise criterion; linearity remains a separate budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 混頻差頻為abs(fRF-fLO)。高側注入下，欲收與鏡像都可落入同一IF，IF濾波器無法事後分離。 展開基準式 100+2*10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列舉欲收與鏡像對LO的差頻：100/120對110均為10；100/140對120均為20。 將兩條推導一起存入 frequency_plan.csv、欲收/鏡像兩條路徑、預選器查核表。

從原理 限匹配的同頻雙埠級聯，Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1；所有F與G用線性功率比，不把此簡式套入未處理鏡像的混頻器。 展開基準式 2+(5-1)/10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先以後級貢獻0.4與0.04逐項相加，再轉dB；確認極大G1極限趨近F1。 將兩條推導一起存入 noise_cascade.csv、線性/dB對照、壓縮排除證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from A difference mixer produces abs(fRF-fLO); with high-side injection, desired and image RF can share an IF and cannot be separated afterward by the IF filter., expand baseline expression 100+2*10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Enumerate the mixer differences: 100 and 120 relative to 110 both give 10; 100 and 140 relative to 120 both give 20. Save both derivations with frequency_plan.csv, desired/image paths and a preselector checklist.

Starting from For matched same-frequency two-port stages, Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1 using linear power ratios; do not apply the shortcut to an untreated mixer image band., expand baseline expression 2+(5-1)/10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Add downstream contributions 0.4 and 0.04 independently, then convert to dB; the large-G1 limit must approach F1. Save both derivations with noise_cascade.csv, linear/dB conversions and compression counterevidence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: UMTS WCDMA：擴頻增益與資料率
related.titleEn: UMTS WCDMA: spreading gain and data rate
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 120 MHz 與 140 MHz，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 120 MHz and 140 MHz, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋250000 symbol/s與62500 symbol/s，建立wcdma_chips.csv、相關峰紀錄、SF速率表，並完成以下驗收：至少100 ksymbol/s需求不接受SF64；若SF16不滿足干擾條件，需降低需求或改善功率控制。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 250000 symbol/s and 62500 symbol/s; create wcdma_chips.csv, correlation-peak records and SF/rate table; apply this acceptance decision: A100 ksymbol/s target rejects SF64; if SF16 fails interference constraints, reduce demand or improve power control.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 混頻差頻為abs(fRF-fLO)。高側注入下，欲收與鏡像都可落入同一IF，IF濾波器無法事後分離。 展開基準式 100+2*10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列舉欲收與鏡像對LO的差頻：100/120對110均為10；100/140對120均為20。 將兩條推導一起存入 frequency_plan.csv、欲收/鏡像兩條路徑、預選器查核表。

從原理 固定chip rate下，符元率與spreading factor成反比；10log10(SF)是理想處理增益指標，不含多使用者干擾。 展開基準式 4000000/16；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：將各符元率乘SF回到4 Mchip/s；畫每個符元含16或64 chip的區塊。 將兩條推導一起存入 wcdma_chips.csv、相關峰紀錄、SF速率表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from A difference mixer produces abs(fRF-fLO); with high-side injection, desired and image RF can share an IF and cannot be separated afterward by the IF filter., expand baseline expression 100+2*10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Enumerate the mixer differences: 100 and 120 relative to 110 both give 10; 100 and 140 relative to 120 both give 20. Save both derivations with frequency_plan.csv, desired/image paths and a preselector checklist.

Starting from At fixed chip rate, symbol rate scales inversely with spreading factor;10log10(SF) is an ideal processing-gain indicator excluding multiuser interference., expand baseline expression 4000000/16; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Multiply symbol rate by SF to recover4 Mchip/s and draw16/64-chip symbol blocks. Save both derivations with wcdma_chips.csv, correlation-peak records and SF/rate table.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
